text: Good afternoon! Welcome to Sam's Diner. What would you like?
Could I have a veggie burger with hash browns, please?
I'm sorry, we don't have any veggie burgers today. Would you like something else?
No worries! Could I have the pasta with tomato sauce, please?
And for dessert? What would you like?
Then I'd like the apple pie with ice cream, please.
I'm sorry, the apple pie is not available today. But the cherry pie is very good.
OK, then the cherry pie, please. With ice cream, please.
Great. Your food will be ready in a few minutes. Enjoy your meal!
Thank you very much. I'm looking forward to it. Have a nice day!
